_meta.purpose: What the result screen sets beside a nutrition table's numbers (D-133): ICMR-NIN's thresholds per 100 g or 100 ml, its daily amounts, and WHO's shares of daily energy. Information only: nothing here changes a score, a band or a headline (D-004).
rules: Every figure is from a primary source read first-hand, with its page (D-046).
Adults only: none of these sources gives children's figures (WHO: for children aged 2 to 15, adjust the adult amount down by energy need, with no number).
Added fat is not applied: packs print total fat, which includes the fat already in the ingredients, so ICMR-NIN's added-fat threshold can't be read off the table.

_source.title: ICMR-NIN, Dietary Guidelines for Indians, 2024, Table 15.1 (nutrients of concern threshold criteria for foods and beverages)
WHO, WHO updates guidelines on fats and carbohydrates (17 July 2023)
WHO, Salt reduction (fact sheet): 1 gram of salt is equivalent to 400 mg of sodium

summary: ICMR-NIN says trans fats should be avoided, and its guide to labels asks you to choose foods that contain no trans fats.
WHO advises that no more than 1% of daily energy come from trans fat.
